title: CASFRI examples
code: ## ensure you are working with enough temp scratch storage space! data_path <- "~/data/CASFRI/v5/Ontario" scratch_path <- ifelse(nzchar(Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR")), Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR"), tempdir())  ## load packages library(forestData) library(terra)  ## national data are large -- set terra to work on disk terraOptions(memfrac = 0.2, tempdir = scratch_path)  ## access (private) CASFRI Ring-of-Fire files on Google Drive googledrive::drive_auth() drive_files <- googledrive::as_id("1E8YjNA8AEt2J44R5z7jz1x799jU1X1J6") |>   googledrive::drive_ls() apply(drive_files, 1, function(f) {   if (!file.exists(file.path(data_path, f$name))) {     googledrive::drive_download(f, path = data_path)   } })  casfri_files <- list(   geo = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_casfri.gdb"), ## geometry attributes   hdr = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_hdr.csv"),    ## header attributes   cas = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_cas.csv"),    ## CAS base polygon attributes   eco = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_eco.csv"),    ## ecological specific attributes   dst = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_dst.csv"),    ## disturbance history attributes   lyr = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_lyr.csv"),    ## forest-level attributes   nfl = file.path(data_path, "CEON_ROF_nfl.csv")     ## non-forest land attributes )  ## Ring-of-Fire study-area boundary rof_zip <- file.path(scratch_path, "ROF_RA_def.zip") googledrive::drive_download(   file = googledrive::as_id("1DzVRglqJNvZA8NZZ7XKe3-6Q5f8tlydQ"),   path = rof_zip,   overwrite = TRUE ) workflowtools::archive_extract_once(rof_zip, dir = scratch_path) rof <- terra::vect(file.path(scratch_path, "ROF_RA_def.shp"))  ## restrict to a single ecodistrict small_study_area <- ecodistricts(destination_path = scratch_path, study_area = rof) small_study_area <- small_study_area[small_study_area$ECODISTRIC == 386, ]  ## NTEMS forest age raster as the template grid template_raster <- ntems("age", scratch_path, study_area = small_study_area)  ## build the CASFRI species percent-cover layers casfri_vect <- casfri_species_cover(casfri_files, study_area = small_study_area) casfri_rast <- casfri_species_layers(casfri_vect, template_raster)  terra::plot(casfri_rast)

what: Download and pre-process NTEMS data for a study area
title: NTEMS examples
code: ## ensure you are working with enough temp scratch storage space! scratch_path <- ifelse(nzchar(Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR")), Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR"), tempdir())  ## load packages library(terra) library(forestData)  ## national rasters are large -- set terra to work on disk terraOptions(   memfrac = 0.2,   tempdir = scratch_path )  ## study area: a ~100 km buffer around a point in central Alberta lcc <- paste(   "+proj=lcc +lat_1=49 +lat_2=77 +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-95",   "+x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs" ) study_area <- terra::vect(cbind(-115, 55), crs = "EPSG:4326") |>   terra::project(lcc) |>   terra::buffer(1e5)  ## CA_forest_harvest_recovery_rate.zip is smallest of the NTEMS archives (~49 MB). ## Only the study-area window is returned. post_harvest_rr <- ntems("harvestrecovery", scratch_path, study_area = study_area)  terra::plot(post_harvest_rr)

title: CASFRI species cover data — casfri_species_cover
text: Extract spatial locations (polygons) forest species layer attributes, create percent cover rasters species optionally provided study area.

title: CASFRI species cover data — casfri_species_cover
code: casfri_species_cover(x, study_area = NULL)  casfri_species_cover.list(x, study_area = NULL)  casfri_species_cover.PqConnection(x, study_area = NULL)  casfri_species_layers(x, raster_to_match)

title: CASFRI species cover data — casfri_species_cover
text: x SpatVector produced via casfri_species_cover() (sf object source readable terra::vect() also accepted). study_area (optional) SpatVector (sf) polygons identifying study area boundaries, used extract subset species cover data (spatial intersection). raster_to_match template SpatRaster defining output grid CRS.

title: CASFRI species cover data — casfri_species_cover
text: SpatVector CASFRI polygons joined species/percent-cover attributes. SpatRaster one percent-cover layer (0-100) per species.

title: CASFRI species cover data — casfri_species_cover
text: x list, must named list elements corresponding CAS tables (e.g., .csv files) geodatabase file (.gdb): HDR: header attributes; CAS: CAS base polygon attributes; LYR: forest-level attributes; NFL: non-forest land attributes; DST: disturbance history attributes; ECO: ecological specific attributes; GEO: geometry attributes. See https://github.com/CASFRI/CASFRI/tree/master/documentation/specifications#common-attribute-schema full details.

title: National eco-boundaries — .ecoboundaries

code: .ecoboundaries(   type = NULL,   destination_path = tempdir(),   study_area = NULL,   raster_to_match = NULL )  ecodistricts(   destination_path = tempdir(),   study_area = NULL,   raster_to_match = NULL )  ecoregions(   destination_path = tempdir(),   study_area = NULL,   raster_to_match = NULL )  ecoprovinces(   destination_path = tempdir(),   study_area = NULL,   raster_to_match = NULL )  ecozones(   destination_path = tempdir(),   study_area = NULL,   raster_to_match = NULL )

title: National eco-boundaries — .ecoboundaries
text: type character. polygon type use: Must one "ECODISTRICT", "ECOREGION", "ECOPROVINCE", "ECOZONE". destination_path character. Path directory data downloaded. study_area (optional) SpatVector (sf) polygons defining study area interest. supplied, boundaries cropped, masked, reprojected (via spatialutils::prep_vector()). raster_to_match (optional) template SpatRaster; supplied, returned vector reprojected CRS.

title: National eco-boundaries — .ecoboundaries
text: SpatVector requested eco-boundary polygons.

title: National eco-boundaries — .ecoboundaries
code: # \donttest{ ## study area: a ~100 km buffer around a point in central Alberta lcc <- paste(   "+proj=lcc +lat_1=49 +lat_2=77 +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-95",   "+x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs" ) study_area <- terra::vect(cbind(-115, 55), crs = "EPSG:4326") |>   terra::project(lcc) |>   terra::buffer(1e5)  ezs <- ecozones(study_area = study_area) terra::plot(ezs, "ZONE_NAME", main = "ecozones in study area")  # }

title: NTEMS data — ntems
text: Get prepare data NTEMS (https://opendata.nfis.org/mapserver/nfis-change_eng.html).

title: NTEMS data — ntems
text: type character, specifying NTEMS product download prepare (see Details). dest_dir character, specifying destination directory download extract data (defaults current working directory). study_area (optional) sf polygon national raster cropped masked.

title: NTEMS data — ntems
text: SpatRaster

title: NTEMS data — ntems
text: type must one following: age: forest age (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2023.113529 ); d2sc: distance--second-class tree species (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 ); fao: forest area based FAO definitions Canada (doi:10.1093/forestry/cpaa006 ); fires, harvest: wildfire harvest disturbances (doi:10.1080/17538947.2016.1187673 ); firesrecovery, harvestrecovery: post-disturbance forest recovery data (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2017.03.035 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.112904 ); firesy2r, harvesty2r: post-disturbance years--recovery (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2017.03.035 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.112904 ); landcover<year>: annual forest landcover 1984-2019 (doi:10.1080/07038992.2018.1437719 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2021.112780 ) leadingspecies: leading tree species (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 ); sbfi: Satellite-Based Forest Inventory (doi:10.1093/forestry/cpad065 ); speciesprobs: tree species probabilities (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 ); wildfirednbr: wildfire differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2014.11.005 ; doi:10.1016/j.rse.2015.09.004 );

title: NTEMS data — ntems
text: Currently supports recent data (made available 2019 later). Previous NTEMS products (e.g., 2015 forest data) can downloaded NTEMS site linked .

what: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
title: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
text: Derive species-group volume raster (m3/ha) two NTEMS products: gross stem volume (2022) multiplied summed per-species likelihood share canopy (2019). post-2014 product distributes species-specific volume directly, reconstructs volume * (sum species likelihoods) / 100.

title: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
code: ntems_species_volume(   species,   study_area = NULL,   dest_dir = NULL,   spp_year = 2019L )

title: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
text: species character vector NTEMS species codes whose likelihoods summed, e.g. c("POPU.TRE", "POPU.BAL", "POPU.GRA") Populus. study_area (optional) SpatVector (sf) crop mask . dest_dir character, destination directory downloads (defaults subdirectory tempdir()). spp_year integer, species-probabilities epoch (default 2019).

title: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
text: SpatRaster species-weighted gross stem volume (m3/ha).

title: NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume — ntems_species_volume
text: requested species layers extracted ~21 GB species probabilities archive (via workflowtools::archive_extract_once, falls back system unzip ZIP64), rasters read lazily; study_area supplied window read. Rasters never reprojected – study-area vector reprojected raster CRS.

Prepare species-layer rasters from SBFI data — prep_species_layers_sbfi
text: gdb_file character, path SBFI .gdb. study_area SpatVector (sf) polygons defining area interest. raster_to_match template SpatRaster defining output grid CRS.

what: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
title: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
text: Build species-group volume raster (m3/ha) Satellite-Based Forest Inventory (SBFI) 2020 geodatabase, stand volume (STRUCTURE_VOLUME_AVG) multiplied summed area share requested species. mirrors ntems_species_volume() construction, SBFI NTEMS volumes directly comparable (share lineage).

title: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
code: sbfi_species_volume(   gdb_file,   species,   study_area,   res = 100,   grid_layer = "_Grid_forested_ecosystem",   tile_fmt = "CA_2020_tile_%d_metrics",   filename = NULL )

title: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
text: gdb_file character, path SBFI .gdb. species character vector SBFI species codes, e.g. c("POPU.TRE", "POPU.BAL", "POPU.GRA"). study_area SpatVector (sf) polygons defining area interest. res numeric, output resolution (m) SBFI native CRS (default 100). grid_layer character, SBFI tile-grid layer name. tile_fmt character, sprintf() format mapping grid Id metrics layer name. filename (optional) character, path write result .

title: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
text: SpatRaster species-weighted stand volume (m3/ha).

title: SBFI species-weighted gross stem volume — sbfi_species_volume
text: SBFI tiles intersecting study_area read, species / volume columns loaded (national geodatabase large). Tiles rasterized SBFI native CRS (raster reprojection; study-area vector reprojected geodatabase CRS) mosaicked. Zeros kept (mapped forest target species), raster's non-NA extent doubles SBFI coverage mask.

title: SCANFI data — scanfi
text: Get prepare SCANFI v2 (Spatialized Canadian National Forest Inventory) data SpatRaster. SCANFI provides wall--wall 30 m maps forest structure, composition, biomass, age Canada (Guindon et al. 2026; doi:10.23687/07653869-f303-46c2-a04e-9ab479b73cbf ).

title: SCANFI data — scanfi
code: scanfi(   type = "all",   years = 2020L,   flavour = c("public", "private"),   dest_dir = NULL,   study_area = NULL,   drive_folder = "1i7w4tO52Sh45tRwlUiUEnwidOeE5Zq68" )

title: SCANFI data — scanfi
text: type character vector layer types fetch (see Details). years integer year(s) fetch (v2 spans 1985-2025 5-year steps). flavour one "public" (default) "private" (see Details). dest_dir character, destination directory downloads (defaults subdirectory tempdir()). study_area (optional) SpatVector (sf) rasters cropped masked. drive_folder Google Drive folder id "private" flavour.

title: SCANFI data — scanfi
text: SpatRaster (one layer per downloaded SCANFI file).

title: SCANFI data — scanfi
text: type selects layers fetch; accepts group aliases "" (default), "structure", "species", /specific tokens . National data large, requested layers downloaded (public flavour) rasters read lazily – study_area supplied, window read disk. Structural attributes age (one layer per requested years): biomass: aboveground biomass (t/ha); closure: total crown closure (%); height: forest height (m); landcover: NFI-compatible land cover classification; age: forest stand age (years). Tree-species crown closure (%; "species" selects ): balsamFir, blackSpruce, broadleaf, douglasFir, jackPine, lodgepolePine, otherConiferous, ponderosaPine, tamarack, whiteRedPine. : mask: northern-extrapolation mask (year-agnostic integer mask). Two flavours available: "public": NRCan public v2 product (https://ftp.maps.canada.ca/pub/nrcan_rncan/Forests_Foret/SCANFI/v2), holding full 1985-2025 time series (5-year steps); "private": periodically-updated Google Drive dataset (2000, 2010, 2020), requires googledrive package Drive authentication.

title: forestData 0.1.1
text: ntems("volume") fetches NTEMS gross stem volume product. ntems_species_volume() derives species-weighted gross stem volume raster (NTEMS volume x summed per-species likelihood share); requested species layers extracted large ZIP64 archive. sbfi_species_volume() derives species-weighted stand volume raster SBFI geodatabase (volume x summed species area share), reading tiles columns needed.

title: forestData 0.1.0
text: Exported functions arguments now use snake_case: casfriSpeciesLayers() now casfri_species_layers(), prepSpeciesLayers_SBFI() now prep_species_layers_sbfi(); arguments studyArea, rasterToMatch, destDir, destinationPath now study_area, raster_to_match, dest_dir, destination_path. casfri_species_layers() now returns SpatRaster (previously RasterStack). ecodistricts(), ecoprovinces(), ecoregions(), ecozones() now return SpatVector (previously sf).

title: forestData 0.1.0
text: scanfi() returns SpatRaster SCANFI v2, type argument select layers flavour argument public (NRCan) private (Google Drive) source. Data downloaded prepared workflowtools spatialutils instead reproducible; national data read lazily / prefiltered study area rather loaded whole. Dataset source URLs centralized R/urls.R. Minimum R version now 4.4.
